title: The Thousand-Kilometer Walk Home
description: Traverse the vast Kenyan wilderness from Kisii across the Rift Valley and eastern savannah to return to sacred Kaya Fungo.

objectives.description: Replenish fresh water supplies at the wilderness spring oasis (+35% Endurance).
Forage healing medicinal herbs along the Rift Valley escarpment trail (+35% Endurance).
Evade the colonial railway telegraph scouts monitoring the eastern plains (+30% Endurance).
Reunite in triumph with the elders at the Sacred Baobab in Kaya Fungo!

reward_text: Mekatilili wa Menza and Wanje have miraculously returned home! The Giriama resistance is reignited.
